thesis: Expected calibrated score is ~78.9 with Compounder as the primary archetype. Adobe combines category leadership, high recurring cash flow, attractive repurchases and a current price near half the locked Base DCF. The central uncertainty is whether AI is a moat-expanding feature layer or a structural substitute. Hard Veto is expected to clear; mechanical sizing is expected in the normal-candidate band, subject to macro pacing 0.7.

evidence.claim: Q3 ARR $27.50B and AI-first ARR >150% y/y.
H1 OCF $5.123B with $4.589B repurchases supports per-share compounding.

counterevidence: Base DCF assumes owner FCF/share nearly doubles over ten years.
falsifiers: If MT or RF fall below Compounder thresholds, reclassify; if price/Base rises >1.2, valuation thesis weakens.
